payload.title: Your notifications: personal settings in the console
payload.description:
**Milestone:** M3, public email and new stories

**Goal.** As an editor or admin, I choose per kind and channel, and can turn off a whole class.

**Build.**
`components/your-notifications.tsx`, reached from the account menu, not the console home (that page is review requests). Buttons in a grid of kinds by channels, with a word and a Lucide mark for on and off. Send a test per channel; my history below. Screenshot review.

**Acceptance.**
Ryan's screenshot approval.

**Depends on:** PPY-44721a
**Related:** kanbus-ff4727, kanbus-222bcf

**Specification.**
```gherkin
Feature: My notification settings
  Scenario: Turning off a class
    Given an admin on their settings
    When they turn off admin alerts
    Then the control says Off in words
    And they stop getting those alerts

  Scenario: Seeing why
    When they open their history
    Then each entry shows the kind, channel and result
```
